text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, and have a formal education background at high school level or above, in good health, above the age of 18 and under the age of 45. Applicants must have completed at least one year of university education. No prior knowledge of the Chinese language is required. Note: As it may close before deadline, so if you want to apply this program, please apply as soon as possible.
